messages:
traffic-monitor-bot: Automated alert — sustained 8x RPS increase on /v1/embeddings from ASN 396982 starting 14:05 UTC. Error rate up to 2.3% 5xx on origin-b.

maya: seeing it on dashboards. big chunk from 185.43.* /64 ranges. spikes are steady, not normal user pattern.

ravi: confirm it's targeting embedding endpoint (large payloads ~>4k tokens), likely abuse for vectorization. rate-limit bucket not triggered yet due to many client IPs.

maya: can we push an emergency WAF rule to block ASN and enable stricter rate limit for /v1/embeddings? quick mitigations: 1) block ASN 396982, 2) apply 5r/s per IP, 3) enable aggressive JS challenge for web origins.

deploy-bot: WAF rule draft posted: ID 482-draft. See rule in edge-console under Security > WAF.

maya: rav, can you apply? I can do edge change if you want.

ravi: applying now. command: `edgectl waf add --match "asn:396982" --action block --scope /v1/embeddings`

ravi: done. WAF rule 482 applied at edge region us-east-1. Rolling to other regions.

deploy-bot: WAF rule 482 applied in 3 regions. Rate-limit policy rl-emb-593 (5r/s per IP) attached to route /v1/embeddings.

tom: any customer impact? we should prepare a status note if any customers see failures.

maya: initial telemetry shows 5xx dropped to 0.4%, latency back to normal. No major customer-facing errors in top 10 customers. recommend watch for false positives.

jen: make sure we capture audit log for who added rule and KMS access for any key usage. tag incident id INC-2026-1842.

liam: ingested audit logs into SIEM, forwarding KMS key usage logs to security bucket now. creating ACL check to ensure only infra role used key.

claire: can we get a short customer-facing blurb? Tom, draft please.

tom: draft: "We experienced a traffic abuse event targeting the embeddings endpoint from a single ASN. We've applied an edge rule and rate limits; service is stable. We're monitoring and will follow up with details."

jen: add "no customer data accessed" line if confirmed.

maya: confirmed no origin auth anomalies, no keys rotated, no evidence of compromise.

ravi: suggest adding ASN to auto-block list for 24h and adding a canary rule for similar patterns.

maya: post-incident actions: 1) add ASN to global denylist for 24h (owner: ravi), 2) update runbook to include embedding endpoint as protected route (owner: maya), 3) tune rate-limit thresholds and alerts (owner: eng-sre), 4) schedule a postmortem (owner: claire). Adding owners here.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-1842 opened, pagerduty alert created, follow-up tasks added to tracker TKT-4567.

claire: will schedule postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC and include security and support. will add regression tests for embedding route.

jen: also request audit export to compliance — include KMS logs and SIEM event ids: SIEM-7891, WAF-482.

maya: thanks all. keeping thread open for 2h for monitoring.

tom: will send customer note after quick edit.
